name.value: Microtel Inn and Suites by Wyndham Kitimat

description.value: The Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Kitimat is a modern budget-oriented chain hotel situated in Kitimat, a remote industrial town on the Douglas Channel in BC's North Coast region. As part of the Wyndham family, it offers standardized amenities in an area with limited accommodation options, making it one of the more reliable lodging choices for cyclists traveling through this part of the province. Kitimat sits at the end of a long fjord with limited onward cycling routes, so the hotel serves primarily as a destination rest point rather than a through-touring waypoint.
